about: Curated per-step labels for scoring the agent, derived from each clip's published LSV error text. trueSkips: steps the operator omitted. errorSteps: steps with a non-skip deviation (a contradiction there counts as a detection). eitherSteps: a skip or a contradiction both count. Any other skipped/out-of-order/contradicted verdict is a false alarm. split: dev clips may be inspected and tuned on; held-out clips are run once after the design lock. unscoredSteps: steps the published labels cannot settle (e.g. excerpts with zero-length windows); verdicts there are neither credited nor counted as false alarms. Splits: dev (tuned on), heldout (run once on the 06e5d90 lock, since used for diagnosis), fresh (untouched until the next lock).
